title: stellaria sanjuanensis
intro: Stellaria sanjuanensis, commonly known as San Juan Stitchwort, is a plant species belonging to the primrose family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of San Juan Stitchwort include wound healing, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory issues such as bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
